newsitem.title: GERMANY: German retailers see Christmas sales up 2 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: German retailers see Christmas sales up 2 bln DM.

text.p: German retailers expect this year's Christmas season sales to be about two billion marks higher than last year, an industry official said on Saturday.
Combined sales in November and December should be about 26 billion marks, said Thomas Werz, spokesman for the Association of German retailers, in a radio interview.

Consumers are gradually getting used to the new longer store opening hours that started on November 1. Stores can now stay open until 2000 hours on weekdays, instead of the previous 18.30 closing time.
"I think many will get the idea in the pre-Christmas season, to make use of that," Werz said.
